name: C065 Kẻ Truyền Mana (Trượng Tụ Linh Truyền Mana)
prompt_ref:
Create a single-cell 1x1 reference sheet of a dark-fantasy Mana Channeler's aether-conduit staff (Trượng Tụ Linh Truyền Mana - C065 Kẻ Truyền Mana) following the exact square cell of the attached reference layout_guide_1x1.png.

COMPOSITION & ORIENTATION (100% MANDATORY):
- Draw ONE complete arcane mana-conduit staff oriented DIAGONALLY from bottom-left (silver-inlaid dark steel shaft) to top-right (two curved brass conductor prongs holding a levitating radiant sapphire-blue mana crystal prism).
- Must show 100% of the entire staff from bottom tip to top sapphire crystal prongs with generous padding inside the frame (occupying 65%-75% of the canvas).
- Zero clipping at canvas edges.

COLOR & BACKGROUND (100% MANDATORY):
- Background MUST be flat solid pure magenta (#FF00FF) edge-to-edge.
- DO NOT use any magenta/pink tones on the staff itself (use gunmetal steel, antique brass, silver filigree, and pure sapphire-cyan mana crystal).
- No character hands, no text, no borders.
prompt_card:
Create a wide horizontal 16:11 dark-fantasy card illustration featuring the exact same Sapphire Mana-Conduit Staff (Trượng Tụ Linh Truyền Mana - C065 Kẻ Truyền Mana) from the attached reference image.

COMPOSITION & BACKGROUND (100% MANDATORY):
- Place the brass-and-steel mana crystal staff diagonally across the center of the horizontal frame.
- Full atmospheric dark-fantasy background (100% opaque RGB illustration, NO magenta, NO transparency): an arcane ley-line chamber where streams of luminous sapphire-cyan mana energy flow through the crystal prism.
- Do NOT draw any card frame, borders, or text.
